outcome: Blood loss from placental delivery to the end of caesarean section
Blood loss from the end of caesarean section to 2 hours postpartum
Need for additional surgical interventions to control postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 100 women aged 20-40 years with 38-40 weeks of gestation who underwent elective caesarean section
finding: Sublingual misoprostol was effective in reducing blood loss, hemoglobin decline, and the need for additional uterotonics or surgical interventions to control postpartum hemorrhage compared to placebo in women undergoing elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on women undergoing elective caesarean section.
